metadataReview.note: The Imperial Gazetteer of India (1908) places Sir Henry Lawrence's engagement against the advancing rebel force at Chinhat, a village on the Faizabad road eight miles from the Lucknow Residency. The atlas point is the gazetteer node for that village. Accounts also name the adjoining hamlet of Ismailganj where contact was made, so this is a village-sector reference, not the rebel line, the British column or the full retreat route. The existing 30 June 1857 date is retained. Strengths, losses and equipment are not inferred; the gazetteer's figure for the rebel force is not adopted.

The Imperial Gazetteer page image names Chinhat as the spot where battle was given and puts it eight miles from the Residency, consistent with this node. This is a named-village reference point, not a surveyed troop position, the Ismailganj hamlet itself or a centre of the whole engagement. No positional accuracy radius is claimed.
